subject: GlowCode / GitHub App — demo & integration questions
messages:
From: Danielle White <danielle.white@glowcode.dev>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question about Redwood GitHub App & demo

Hi Soojin,

We recently signed up for the Redwood trial (self-serve) and I was testing the GitHub App flow. I'm an infra/platform engineer on the developer tools team at GlowCode and we're exploring ways to integrate inference into our CI and some repo tooling (pre-commit checks and a couple of internal bots). Before we get deeper, a few quick questions:

- Does the GitHub App support installation on org-level monorepos with multiple app manifests?
- How does auth work for repo-scoped tokens vs. a service account for CI?
- Any guidance on using Redwood from GitHub Actions (we're worried about secrets/execution cost)?

Would love to sync with someone for a 30-minute demo/technical walkthrough next week. Our timezone is PDT. Is that something your team can do?

Thanks,
Danielle
Danielle White
Senior Platform Engineer, GlowCode
@glowcode on GitHub

- Approximate repo count / repo sizes (single large monorepo vs many small repos)?
- Do you expect to run inference on hosted Redwood (our API) or via a private deployment (VPC/on-prem)?

I have availability next week:
- Thu 2026-09-09 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET (30m)
- Fri 2026-09-10 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET (30m)

I've attached a one-pager about our GitHub App and a short pre-demo checklist to help you collect the info we'll need (see attachment stub). I've cc'd Marissa (AE) to join the call for contract/next-step discussion if we decide to proceed.

If either slot works, reply with who else will join and any CI examples you'd like us to reproduce.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
